**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

| Playbook element | Document |
|---|---|
| Transition assistance up to 6 months at then-current rates | §11.1 — six months on Customer's request, at the rates in the expiring Order Form (**better than preferred**: locks legacy pricing) |
| Data return in standard machine-readable format within 30 days | §11.2 — thirty days, "complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with relationships and metadata" |
| Deletion + certification thereafter | §11.3 — secure deletion from active systems and backups, certified in writing by an authorized officer |

Additional customer-favourable protections worth noting: Vendor cannot withhold Customer Data over a fee dispute (§11.2), deletion is only triggered *after* we confirm successful return (§11.3), and any legally-required retained copy stays protected and purpose-limited. §10.1 independently preserves our Customer Data rights post-termination and expressly contemplates the transition period, so there is no hidden conditioning of data return on payment.
